hero.title: Celebrate Life's Special Moments at Raja Bali
hero.body: From intimate gatherings to grand celebrations, Raja Bali offers elegant venues, authentic Balinese cuisine, and warm hospitality in Bali's Nusa Dua area.

intro.heading: A Venue Designed for Every Occasion
intro.body: From birthday celebrations and corporate dinners to family reunions, anniversaries, and wedding receptions, Raja Bali provides a beautiful setting where authentic Balinese hospitality meets exceptional cuisine.

whatsIncluded.heading: What's Included
whatsIncluded.subheading: Every detail has been thoughtfully prepared to ensure an enjoyable and memorable experience.

items.title: Birthday Celebrations
items.desc: Celebrate another memorable year with family and friends in a warm Balinese setting.

items.title: Wedding & Engagement
items.desc: Create unforgettable moments surrounded by authentic Balinese charm and exceptional hospitality.

items.title: Family Gatherings
items.desc: Reconnect over authentic Balinese cuisine in a welcoming atmosphere.

items.title: Corporate Events
items.desc: Host business dinners, team gatherings, and corporate celebrations with confidence.

items.title: Tour Groups
items.desc: Comfortable group dining with authentic Balinese cuisine and attentive service.

items.title: Private Celebrations
items.desc: From anniversaries to reunions, every occasion deserves a memorable setting.

eventSpaces.heading: Event Spaces
eventSpaces.intro: Thoughtfully designed for every occasion, our event spaces combine authentic Balinese charm, warm hospitality, and exceptional cuisine.

spaces.title: Indoor Dining
spaces.desc: Elegant indoor space with authentic Balinese interiors.

spaces.title: Garden Area
spaces.desc: A tropical outdoor setting perfect for relaxed celebrations.

spaces.title: Group Dining
spaces.desc: Comfortable seating arrangements for larger parties.

spaces.title: Private Event Setup
spaces.desc: Customized layouts tailored to your occasion.

eventSpaces.eventPlanningBody: From seating arrangements and menu selections to special decorations and entertainment, our team is here to help personalize your event and ensure a smooth, enjoyable experience from beginning to end.

gallery.body: Showcase beautifully captured moments from birthdays, family gatherings, corporate dinners, wedding receptions, and private events.
